mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% in 80% of instances but 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 235.0 signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 235.0 in 80% of instances but 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5.0%, it signals a strong economy with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In 80% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and UNRATE < 5.0, 60-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising > 0.3 percentage points over 3 months), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: In 80% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, 20-day forward returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) signals a tight labor market, which increases the risk of inflation and central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 5.0 in 80% of instances but 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly HOUST reading below 1000.0 signals weak housing demand, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1000.0 in 80% of instances but 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO reading below 100.0 signals weak industrial production, indicating a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 in 80% of instances but 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly RSAFS reading below 400000.0 signals weak consumer spending, which is a leading indicator of economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 400000.0 in 80% of instances but 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of those instances.
